# Microduck 3D model

Copyright Pollen Robotics.
Source: https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl
Commit: 0daab160d3fb1c2cbaba16a4a19052f36709dd9e
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/

Modified: official STL visual meshes converted to indexed binary geometry, assembled with MJCF transforms in the official standing pose, and recolored. Converted mesh adaptation remains CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. These are visualization assets, not manufacturing instructions.

GPU-free views: rasterized from the same original meshes with a depth buffer, original part masks, and approximate lighting. View images retain the same CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.
